readout_other: seizure latency (video); elevated plus maze; Western blotting (Bcl-2, Bax, TNF-a, IL-1b, JNK pathway); c-Fos immunohistochemistry; H&E and Nissl staining
direction_notes: LIPUS prolonged seizure latency (6 vs 7 days), improved EPM anxiety-like behaviour and reduced apoptosis and inflammation markers in kainic acid epileptic mice, while c-Fos expression increased in cortex, CA1 and CA3.
safety_notes: H&E and Nissl staining showed no bleeding or tissue damage seven days after stimulation.

exposures.label: LIPUS of left cortex and hippocampus, PRF 1 kHz and 10 Hz

target.label: left cortex and hippocampus (including CA1 and CA3)

timing.protocol_description: PRF 1 kHz (or 10 Hz), duty cycle 50%, burst duration (BD) 1 s, interstimulus interval 4 s (text) for 30 min/day for seven consecutive days; the Fig. 1 legend gives ISI = 3 s. Behavioural tests and c-Fos used the 1-kHz PRF only.
